entries.reason: sarib-design fonts.md (a): next/font/local loads the vendored Google Sans Flex and Code under hashed family names, so the font-family tokens point at its CSS variables (the same override syedsarib.com makes).

syrup's motion tokens (docs/MOTION.md §3) are literal ms because src/lib/motion.ts mirrors them for JS exit timeouts and scripts/check-motion.mjs fails when the two differ; the values are the design system's fast/base/slow.
The skeleton's 160ms don't-flash wait before it appears: a threshold, not a motion pattern (MOTION.md §1).
Server-side only: the OG image renderer (Satori) needs TTF/OTF, which the vendored woff2 set can't supply; no browser ever requests Google.
